mapper.sql:
FROM bookmarks b JOIN destinations d ON d.id = b.target_id JOIN destination_translations dt ON dt.destination_id = d.id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' JOIN country_categories cc ON cc.id = d.region_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.target_type = 'DESTINATION'
AND d.region_id IN (SELECT id FROM korea_regions)
AND d.region_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM korea_regions)
mapper.select:
SELECT b.target_id AS targetId, dt.name, cc.region_name AS regionName, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnailUrl, b.created_at AS bookmarkCreatedAt
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql:
SELECT b.id AS bookmarkId, b.target_id AS targetId, 'post' AS boardType, p.post_type AS postType, p.title, u.nickname,
(u.status = 'DEACTIVATED') AS writerWithdrawn, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.views, b.created_at AS bookmarkCreatedAt FROM bookmarks b JOIN user_posts p ON p.id = b.target_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.target_type = 'POST' AND p.post_type IN ('QUESTION', 'TIP') AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT b.id AS bookmarkId, b.target_id AS targetId, 'course' AS boardType, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS postType, c.title, CASE c.course_kind WHEN 'OFFICIAL' THEN 'TripBora' ELSE u.nickname END AS nickname, CASE c.course_kind WHEN 'OFFICIAL' THEN FALSE ELSE (u.status = 'DEACTIVATED') END AS writerWithdrawn, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.views, b.created_at AS bookmarkCreatedAt FROM bookmarks b JOIN courses c ON c.id = b.target_id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.target_type = 'COURSE' AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

FROM bookmarks b JOIN travel_info ti ON ti.id = b.target_id JOIN info_categories ic ON ic.id = ti.category_id AND ic.is_visible = 1 WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.target_type = 'TRAVEL_INFO'
AND ti.scope = #{scope}
mapper.select:
SELECT b.target_id AS targetId, ti.title, ti.scope, ti.content_type AS contentType, ic.id AS categoryId, ic.name AS categoryName, ( SELECT ii.image_url FROM info_images ii WHERE ii.info_id = ti.id AND ii.is_main = 1 ORDER BY ii.order_index ASC, ii.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnailUrl, ti.created_at AS createdAt, b.created_at AS bookmarkCreatedAt
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
